Title: The LORD Shall Fight for You
Promise: Moses urged Israel to stay calm and watch for deliverance, telling them God would take up their battle for them and they need not fight for themselves. Doubt: The words are Moses speaking to the people, not a direct divine 'I will' speech in the text, and the assurance is tied to one battle at the Red Sea rather than a standing covenant promise; it also overlaps the deliverance promise already covered at Exodus 3:7-8.
